StrictRule: After every architecture review gate, if the architecture direction or proof is weak, a corrective subbundle must be created, completed, and revalidated before downstream work continues.
Notes: Do not begin implementation until the prepared-stage validator passes.
Treat canonicality, validation purity, concurrency, and differential persistence as the blocking foundations of the initiative.
Keep `ProcessesService` as a thin façade if that minimizes churn, but do not let the façade remain the actual logic owner.
Do not centralize helpers into a dumping ground; extract only with ownership clarity.
Do not close the bundle without fresh build, test, browser, and completed-stage validator proof.
